## About
Fells Point Auto sits on Eastern Ave in Baltimore. We're an authorized safety inspection station in Maryland, and we also take on everything from minor repairs to major engine overhauls.
Our team includes Amir Sohaib, our mechanic supervisor, and Ali Syed, our auto inspector. Customers who've had Ali do their MD inspection say he's thorough, takes the time to show you what needs work, and looks after the car like his own.
No upselling, no gimmicks. We give only the recommendations we think your vehicle needs to stay on the road safely. We're rated 4.2 from 167 Google reviews.

## Services
- Maryland Auto State Inspection: As an authorized safety inspection station in Maryland, we check brakes, steering, lights, exhaust, safety belts and more.
- Diagnostics & Inspections: Our technicians use advanced diagnostic tools to track down even complex issues and give you an accurate assessment.
- Engine Repair: Check engine light, strange noises or a drop in performance. We diagnose it and use quality parts to restore your engine's power and reliability.
- Transmission repairs: From oil changes to engine or transmission repairs, no job is too big or too small for us.
- Tire Repair: Tire repair, replacement and rotation. We can also help you find good prices on new tires when it's time to replace them.
- Oil Change: A quick, stress-free oil change with synthetic, synthetic blend and conventional motor oil brands on hand.
- Small engine needs: Our shop has room for large and small vehicles, plus snow blowers, tractors and golf carts.

## FAQ
Q: Can you do my Maryland state inspection?
A: Yes. Fells Point Auto is an authorized safety inspection station in Maryland.

Q: What do you check during an inspection?
A: We check various parts of your vehicle, including brakes, steering, lights, exhaust, safety belts and more.

Q: What kind of oil do you use?
A: Our shop is equipped with multiple synthetic, synthetic blend and conventional motor oil brands.

Q: Do you work on things other than cars?
A: Yes. We have space for large and small vehicles, and we also take snow blowers, tractors, golf carts and other small engine needs.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
